items.why: Shares surge about 33% as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia, adding roughly $1tn in value and lifting the Nasdaq.
Volatility plunges as stocks rebound after the AI-driven selloff pushed major indexes into correction.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Riding the AI rebound as Nvidia's surge on Huang's return lifts the whole sector.

market_note: Dow futures jumped 800 points and the Nasdaq soared 3% after entering correction territory.
summary: Stocks are roaring back after a steep slide, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang's return. The Nasdaq is up about 7% and the S&P 500 is rebounding 5% as buyers step back in.
